narrative: On the morning of 28 October 2026, plain-clothes Tamil Nadu police personnel allegedly picked up A. Kalaiyarasan, economist and Associate Professor at the Madras Institute of Development Studies (MIDS), Chennai, at around 5:00 AM, in connection with abusive content posted by a fake Instagram account impersonating him; according to contemporaneous accounts he was released and dropped back home at around 7:45 AM the same morning without being formally arrested or charged. His complaint letter to the DGP names the stated destination as T4 Sankar Nagar Police Station, Pammal (a Tambaram City Police station), says he was driven in a rented car (not a police vehicle), and that the impersonation account @yourvijayamani used as its profile picture his photograph from the Harvard University website. The account was verified live on 2026-10-29 (2 followers; see data/evidence/2026-10-29-yourvijayamani-osint/OSINT-NOTE.md), with its profile picture matching his Harvard Mittal Institute portrait. The episode came days after he appeared in a television interview discussing rising prices in Tamil Nadu. The same day, he sent the complaint letter to the Director-General of Police, Tamil Nadu, seeking intervention and a record of the episode. No officer has been identified; no FIR against any police personnel and no inquiry into the detention is known as of 29 October 2026.
status_detail: Complaint letter to the DGP, Tamil Nadu, dated 28 October 2026, seeking intervention. Released without formal arrest or charge; no FIR against police personnel and no departmental or magisterial inquiry known as of 28 October 2026. Note: a separate FIR relating to the impersonation matter may exist against unknown persons; this entry tracks accountability for the detention itself.

editor_notes: Tier 3 per Constitution Art. III: multiple independent accounts by named individuals, led by a RedInk-awardee journalist, plus the victim's own complaint letter (a primary document, self-published). No video, FIR, medical record or court order yet exists for the detention itself; tier should be revisited if any of those surface. Officers are wholly unidentified — recorded as plain-clothes personnel per Art. I 1.1 unit rule. CAUTION FOR FUTURE EDITORS: the Madras HC Madurai Bench order in Innisai v. State of Tamil Nadu, HCP(MD) No. 1359 of 2026 (23 October 2026, G.R. Swaminathan & P. Murugan JJ) concerns Inspector Sugumaran of District Crime Branch, Thanjavur, arrested in an extortion case — a DIFFERENT matter that surfaced in the same news cycle and was conflated with this case in at least one AI-generated summary post. Do not merge. OSINT UPDATE 2026-10-29: impersonation account verified live as @yourvijayamani ('vijaya manikandan', bio 'Research analyst | cosmopolitan', 2 followers/35 following, still active after the incident); profile picture matches his Harvard Mittal Institute portrait exactly; account's own posts are repost memes (one Aug 2026 post captioned 'Elaathaium adipom' = 'we'll beat everyone'); Google-indexed comments 'Kanja college'/'Kanjaavum' on TVK-tagged posts corroborate an abusive-comment pattern (Tier 4 snippets). The specific comment about MLA Kamatchi rests on the victim's letter only. Operator identity unverifiable from public surface; per Art. II we do not attempt identification. Evidence pack: data/evidence/2026-10-29-yourvijayamani-osint/. Watch items: DGP office response, any FIR/inquiry into the detention, whether the State Police Complaints Authority route is invoked (note: under s.12 of the TN Police (Reform) Act 2013 the SPCA entertains only death in custody, rape, or grievous hurt in custody, so this detention falls outside its statutory mandate), and any repetition of the pattern. OSINT ADDENDUM (2026-10-29, see data/evidence/2026-10-29-yourvijayamani-osint/OSINT-NOTE.md): the impersonation account was located and verified live — @yourvijayamani ('vijaya manikandan', 'Research analyst | cosmopolitan', 2 followers / 35 following, 3 posts), user ID 35523406537; its profile picture verified by direct comparison as the victim's Harvard Mittal Institute portrait. Fifteen Google-indexed comments (2 Sept – 24 Oct 2026) show a slur-trolling persona embedded in TVK-ecosystem Instagram threads (TVK MLAs' fan reels, TVK IT Wing coordinator @irfanchennai_official, TVK media), including one anti-DMK slur — an indiscriminate troll pattern, not a partisan operative. No public-surface evidence supports the account being police-created; recorded as unsupported, not disproven — operator identity is determinable only via Meta records (creation date, signup details, login IPs), which the investigating agency could have summoned under BNSS s.94 within hours and did not, instead detaining the photograph's owner. Follower/following identities are login-walled and must come via Meta preservation/disclosure. Account was still live and active as of 2026-10-29 — preservation urgency flagged.
